Toxapex

Poison Water

Alola · Generation 7

Toxapex is a Poison/Water-type Brutal Star Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 14.5 kg. It evolves from Mareanie. Its highest base stat is Defense (152), with a base stat total of 495.
